name: Tappuah
overview: Tappuah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Hebron. His mention in Scripture is concise and centers on his lineage within the tribe of Judah, with no additional personal notes recorded.
namesAndTitles: The name Tappuah is a proper name meaning "apple" in Hebrew. This name is not indicated as being given directly by God, and it appears in the biblical record simply as a personal designation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Tappuah was the son of Hebron and that he himself fathered Korah. Beyond these relationships, no further family connections are detailed.
scriptureSignificance: Tappuah's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah. As the son of Hebron and father of Korah, he contributes to the biblical record of the lineage that shapes the history and identity of the tribe. His mention helps to preserve the continuity of God's chosen people through their ancestral lines.
